svg.text: Accuracy on pairs never trained on, never shown to Opus
What Opus did on one task, in Python it wrote itself
Skill 1, top corner of its 32 × 32 table.
A blank pair was never shown to Opus.
Rows a=0 and a=1 agree, so
a=0 and a=1 carry one hidden code.
Opus found a code for all 32 values of a and b.
It explains every training answer of skill 1
Never shown: a=0, b=4 gives 6 OR 5 = 7
Other skills, other rules: skill 0 is a sum,
skill 2 is the stronger side wins.
one unit per bit of the code, on
when that bit is 0 in both codes
turns each unit fully on or off
reads the 4 bits as the answer
No gradients. Training speed set to 0.
One Opus run per task. Training's reading is its best step of 6,000, which favours training.
